Name: Assign Decoy
Description: Use to make one chosen ally more likely to be targeted by enemies for 1 turn. Effect is removed after ally is targeted by or otherwise damaged by foes 3 times.

Name: Flare
Description: When attacking with tomes, inflicts Res-20% on foe, and unit recovers 50% of damage dealt. [Dragon] Critical rate is doubled. [Mystical] Extra -10% to foe’s Res. [Qi Adept] Unit recovers 100% of damage dealt instead.

Name: Cataclysm
Description: Use to attack foes in an area with fire, thunder and wind magic at 40% damage. Wind is effective: Flying. [Dragon] Sets terrain on fire. [Mystical] +10% damage. [Qi Adept] 20% chance of breaking target.

Name: Cataclysm+
Description: Use to attack foes in an area with fire, thunder and wind magic at 40% damage. Wind is effective: Flying. [Dragon] Sets terrain on fire. [Mystical] +10% damage. [Qi Adept] 20% chance of breaking target.
